name: hebrew-excel-kit
description: Hebrew RTL Excel for AI coding agents: skill, verifier, repair tool, design system, CFO-grade skill stack, demo workbook with real PivotTables and XLOOKUP.

optional.pywin32: Windows only. Enables `verify_rtl.py --com` and `demo/com_finish.py` (real PivotTables + cached formula values through Excel's COM API).

mcp_servers.notes: File-level read/write/format/chart/pivot. First launch downloads and builds the package; warm the cache once or the 30s MCP handshake times out. Use stdio — the HTTP transport binds 0.0.0.0 by default. Does NOT set RTL — run fix_rtl.py on its output.

Drives the REAL Excel engine via COM: recalculation, PivotTables, Power Query, DAX, VBA, range screenshots. Fills the two gaps file-level tools have: formulas that never evaluate, and no way to prove what Excel actually renders. Disclosure: release builds carry opt-out anonymous telemetry (tool names, duration, hashed machine id — never file paths, cell values or formulas).

skills.name: hebrew-excel-rtl
skills.why: Hebrew RTL Excel: per-sheet RTL, reading order, Israeli formats, manager-readable design, per-sheet self-check, repair tool. Nothing equivalent exists on any marketplace.

skills.name: xlsx
skills.why: Anthropic's official spreadsheet skill: the zero-formula-errors gate (recalc.py), messy-file intake, the external-link trap. First-party.
skills.clone_note: On Windows clone with `git -c core.longpaths=true` — the repo holds schema paths that overflow the 260-char limit.

skills.name: excel-hygiene
skills.why: Independent 'second pair of eyes': deterministic mechanical checker (number-as-text, hardcode-over-formula, truncated SUM, percent x100) plus the Panko-Halverson spreadsheet-error taxonomy. Apache-2.0.

skills.name: audit-xls

skills.name: clean-data-xls
skills.why: Normalize messy raw spreadsheets: whitespace, casing, numbers-as-text, dates, dedupe, mixed-type columns. The intake step for any inherited file.

install_targets.claude-desktop: Settings > Capabilities > Skills — ZIP upload, one per skill

demo.finish_note: com_finish.py needs Windows + Excel: it creates the real PivotTables and saves cached formula values. NEVER re-save the finished file with openpyxl — that deletes the charts and the pivots.
